components.name: Filled action
components.description: Browser approximation of the native 64dp Start control. The idle screen has a remembered Run/Walk/Hike picker, without a map. Native ripple/focus, app locale and font scaling remain Android-owned.

components.name: Outlined action
components.description: Secondary Finish action beside Resume in the paused/recovered island. Browser preview uses the existing general control; native active buttons are 60dp, or 48dp in landscape.

components.name: Record and Activities tabs
components.description: Native Record/Activities tabs with Tabler icons and labels on idle/history screens. Both active recording and saved replay hide the tabs for a full-content map. Static preview does not navigate.

components.name: Live distance
components.description: One active-island metric column at nominal 26sp; native values fit between 16sp and 26sp. The island uses three equal distance/time/average-pace columns.

components.name: Run row
components.description: Flat whole-row native target with stored activity type/date, distance and time/pace. Values in this documentation preview are illustrative, not bundled user history. Legacy untyped sessions remain Run.

components.name: Satellite map shell
components.description: Active recording and saved replay fill the content area behind floating controls and a bottom island, lower left in landscape. The idle activity picker has no map. Navigation hides the world-scale view behind loading until a fix arrives, then follows at zoom 18. Static placeholder contains no imagery or invented route; real imagery keeps its colors.
components.html: Satellite imagery

components.name: Split row
components.description: A compact ruled row with equal columns, muted label and end-aligned value. This example has no measured data.

components.name: Replay controls
components.description: 48dp Play/Pause and speed controls in the replay island, with a seek bar and time/pace. Default chooses the available multiplier closest to a 30-second observed replay; options 1×, 5×, 10×, 30×, 60×, 120×, 240× and 480×. A close zoom-18 arrow/camera follows the observed path, with safe gaps preserved. Backgrounding pauses playback. Documentation buttons do not play a route.

components.name: Missing elevation profile
components.description: Native 160dp relative elevation-change profile in the details sheet. Climb/descent lead; raw altitude/range are secondary. Preserve missing-height/segment gaps. GPS estimates have no terrain correction or grade percentages. No measured profile is fabricated here.
components.html: No GPS elevation data

components.name: Export GPX control
components.description: Accessible 48dp replay download control opens Downloads, Save to… and Share file choices. Native destinations may include compatible Drive providers. Saved outcomes show the real filename and explicit Share. No automatic account sync or claim of recipient completion.

components.name: Voice coach entry
components.description: Off-by-default entry before recording and in active options. Opens a native sheet with guidance/goal controls, default-on optional pace/encouragement/terrain/lap feedback and installed-voice preview. This browser button is illustrative and speaks nothing.

components.name: History chart filters
components.description: 48dp type controls filter only four-calendar-week charts, not the history list or whole-history export. Long translated labels scroll horizontally. Static preview.

components.name: History chart empty state
components.description: Native charts use labelled weekly distances and accessible values, with a type-specific pace trend only when sufficient observations exist. This empty-state preview contains no invented measurements.

components.name: Whole-history transfer
components.description: Share all and Export all offer standalone CSV summary or ZIP with every saved GPX, summary and README. Recipients/providers are chosen in Android; no automatic upload is implied.

narrative.overview: Version 0.7 retains the monochrome native system and expands to 27 pinned Tabler icons. It adds independently switchable offline coaching, 68 varied phrases per language, conservative loop/quarter comparisons, optional Anthropic live advice/reviews/training, editable activity journals/private photos, equal-height localized share actions and close-follow replay with a multiplier chosen near 30 seconds. AI is off by default; keys stay protected and coordinates/photos are excluded from AI summaries. Existing activity capture/recovery remains independent. No v0.7 test or runtime claim is made by this design preview. Historical v0.6 retained monochrome controls, one Tabler family, activity selection and full-content live/replay maps. Phone language is the default with English fallback and Spanish support. Optional voice coaching is off by default and configured before or during recording; installed offline TTS and temporary audio focus do not alter capture. Four local calendar-week charts compare like activity types. GPX, coordinate-free CSV summaries and route-bearing ZIP files can be saved/shared through Android, including compatible Drive providers. No Strava or automatic cloud sync. Its final integrated builds passed 96 JVM tests and lint with zero errors/37 warnings; 24 pinned icons and 270 English/Spanish resources passed source/parity and placeholder checks. Bounded API 34 review of 11 screenshots found no material UI issues in the inspected views. README.md#version-06-verification records exact runtime/release evidence and remaining checks; historical v0.5 results remain separate.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic day/night controls; real-color map imagery and one Tabler outline family.
Short localized Spanish/English labels, native font scaling and accessible icon actions.
Activity picker before capture; full-content live/replay maps with reachable bottom islands.
Climb/descent and relative elevation profile first; raw GPS altitude is secondary.
Display-only safe live interpolation; observed replay with explicit missing-data gaps.
Portable readable GPX filenames, no guessed street or account/browser flow.
State-aware notifications; Android/user settings govern lock-screen presentation.
Optional service-owned voice cues, concise goal settings and explicit preview/unavailable states.
Four labelled weekly distance bars; type-specific pace trends with missing-data semantics.
Explicit GPX/CSV/ZIP save/share choices through native providers, independent of chart filtering.

rules.name: Neutral chrome, real imagery
rules.body: Use paired neutral roles and visible credits. Imagery and supplied labels retain source colors. No extra accent palette.

rules.name: Short labels, honest states
rules.body: Translate app controls, errors and notifications. Use — for unknown data. Keep GPS estimates, observed replay time and active time distinct.

rules.name: Display is separate from capture
rules.body: Map loading and safe movement interpolation never change stored GPS samples, distance or exports. Maps request visible tiles, not raw activity files. Pause animations/playback in the background and preserve gaps.

rules.name: Elevation changes first
rules.body: Emphasize climb/descent and a relative GPS profile. Preserve missing-height/segment gaps; raw altitude is secondary. Do not imply terrain correction or grade percentages.

rules.name: Explicit file export
rules.body: Prepare GPX/CSV/ZIP off the UI thread, show the actual filename and offer explicit Share. Android owns destination choice, including compatible Drive targets. Failed/cancelled exports preserve recordings; showing a chooser does not prove recipient upload. Whole-history exports include all saved activities, not only chart-filtered rows.

rules.name: Optional voice independent of capture
rules.body: Keep speech off by default and settings in a native sheet. Installed offline voice availability and temporary audio focus can affect prompts but never recording. Do not directly alter global media volume or promise player-specific ducking.

rules.name: Comparable chart data
rules.body: Use four local calendar weeks and disclose the partial current week. Compare pace within one activity type, weight aggregate pace by distance and leave missing values unavailable. Never infer that chart filters also limit export.

dos: Use only pinned Tabler icons for app pictograms.
Keep download accessible above replay and details available by tapping its island.
Use native font scaling, localized labels and explicit recovery states.
Keep credits, GPS gaps and unavailable elevation visible.
Preserve activity type; old untyped sessions stay Run.
Follow phone language unless an explicit supported override is selected.
Keep voice guidance optional and time goals explicit about excluding pauses.
Use native share/picker destination selection and separate CSV summaries from route-bearing ZIPs.
donts: Do not recolor imagery or add colored controls.
Do not infer activity type from speed or a filename street from route coordinates.
Do not invent missing measurements, corrected terrain heights or grade percentages.
Do not animate across GPS gaps or describe smoothing as increased GPS accuracy.
Do not claim export uploads or connects an account.
Do not treat browser previews or historical emulator evidence as current native verification.
Do not promise Spotify/headphone ducking or a completed Drive upload without device/recipient evidence.
Do not compare mixed activity types as a single pace trend.
